# Memory

Get the memory usage of target hosts. `osapi behavior get --name memory` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                                 |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                |
| Description | Get the memory usage of the host                                                                                                                    |
| Detail      | Reads the total, the free and the used memory, in bytes. Used is the total less what is available, which includes the cache, as free(1) reports it. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                 |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/memory                                                                                                               |
| Permission  | memory:read                                                                                                                                         |
| Command     | [osapi client node memory get](../../../usage/cli/client/node/memory/get.md)                                                                        |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                                            |
| Output type | Entry                                                                                                                                               |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

| ------ | ------ | ---------------------- |
| memory | object | The memory of the host |
